audience: Frontend developers with 2–5 years of experience; app import and interview practice

versions.ECMAScript: ES2024 baseline and standardized later features; ES2026 published
versions.TypeScript: 5.9-compatible as requested; current documentation also lists 6.0

topic_map.JS: 001–038 values, coercion, declarations, everyday collections; 039–105 closures, this, objects, functional transformations, modules, iterators; 106–150 descriptors, proxies, weak references, advanced cloning and composition
topic_map.REACT: 001–025 rendering, JSX, props, state, forms; 026–070 effects, refs, reducer, context, memoization, custom hooks; 071–100 Suspense, transitions, actions, use, compiler, architecture
topic_map.NEXT: 001–016 routing and component boundaries; 017–045 request APIs, server actions, metadata, assets, rendering and caching; 046–065 cache configuration, streaming, advanced routes and security
topic_map.TS: 001–011 basic structural types and narrowing; 012–031 generics, utilities, React types and configuration; 032–045 conditional, infer, mapped, template-literal and API design
topic_map.HCT: 001–011 HTML semantics and CSS basics; 012–031 layout, forms, responsive CSS and Tailwind utilities; 032–045 cascade, containers, relational selectors and Tailwind theming
topic_map.DOM: 001–006 selection and events; 007–017 observers, storage, fetch and history; 018–025 workers, CORS, rendering and browser lifecycles
topic_map.ASYNC: 001–006 promises and await; 007–017 combinators, queues and cancellation; 018–025 async iterators, cleanup and concurrency
topic_map.PAS: 001–006 metrics, labels and metadata; 007–017 loading, keyboard, focus and SEO; 018–025 profiling, memory, composite widgets and architecture
topic_map.DBG: 001–005 basic data and UI bugs; 006–014 races, effects and layout; 015–020 cross-layer caching, stores, accessibility and resource ownership

type_plan: Every sheet includes MCQ, Conceptual, Scenario, Find the Bug, Fix the Code or Write Code, and Follow-up; executable sheets also include Predict Output and Code Trace. Aim above 50% code coverage.
summary_policy: Compute all Overview counts from JSON at build time and store them as text to honor the all-text requirement. No workbook formulas.
